_doc: Arm registry of the evaluation tools (tools/eval, SPDX BSD-3-Clause): the arms of AMENDMENTS A46 (U, L-PVT, T, T-pr,
T-dop, T-tdcp; A-FA / A-FA-norej / T-reject / T+floor / L-SPP are not run). ASCII '-' stands for the '−' of the design documents.
traj: the trajectory eval_ate.py scores (TEST_PLAN §4 E1): U traj_W; GNSS arms traj_N, completed before ACTIVATE with
traj_W mapped by the activation-time T_{N<-W} (A52, tools/eval/e1traj.py); every arm's traj_W is also scored (E4).
overlay: repository file (P3-B owns config/arms/**) loaded AFTER config/m3dgr_avia.yaml by a per-run wrapper launch
that run_matrix.py writes into the run directory, so its keys win (roslaunch: last setting of a key wins, dicts are
unrolled into leaf parameters). The overlay is read from the worktree of the build that runs the arm.
build: which remote build the arm runs on; run_matrix.py maps it with --devel <build>=<worktree>:<devel dir>.
A55: every arm, U included, runs on the one HEAD eval build (head); U = HEAD with gnss.enable false (config/arms/U.yaml),
bit-identical to ref-R by the G-zero-channel gate, so the seed semantics (A30) are those of the GNSS arms.
gnss_inputs: true = run_matrix.py adds a per-sequence overlay with gnss.nav_rinex (A38/A45: required) and
gnss.time.calib_file (A18) after the arm overlay.
time_calib: false (A81; default true) = the arm does not read the A18 time-calibration file: run_matrix.py gives it the
nav_rinex overlay without gnss.time.calib_file (the LIVGO-literal arms: the paper's time alignment is the online DTW only).
The manifest records the value per arm.
calibration: true = a development-set calibration arm of TEST_PLAN §3 (AMENDMENTS A58) or diagnostic arm (A62: *-nofj =
the arm with the A61 F9 frame-jump detector off, *-noodom = without the F13 odometry output; A67/A70: *-nocons = the
Doppler rows' full tilt content (the pre-A66 gain: neither the A66 consider entry nor the A70 projection); T-qos = T with the
open-sky q_tilt/q_tv; A70: T-consider = T with the A66 consider entry instead of the A70 projection (the A66 T),
T-proj-consider = T with both (the A67 D2 diagnostic)), never an evaluation arm.

U.label: FAST-LIVO2 (ours, U = HEAD with gnss.enable false = R)

LIVGO.label: FAST-LIVGO reproduction (Doppler + fixed-anchor TDCP, DTW, frozen W-ENU, Hessian dual mode); not an evaluation arm

LIVGO-legacy.label: LIVGO control: activate() frame (no III-C2 least squares), same dual-mode rejection

LIVGO-legacy-p2.label: LIVGO-legacy plus the P2 observer (A75 revision 1): the negative control of the TDCP share of the host position variance; outputs equal LIVGO-legacy's

LIVGO-norej.label: LIVGO-legacy with L4/L5 chi-square off (paper Ours w/o Rejection)

LIVGO-v2.label: LIVGO-v2 (A75): exact frame (tilt, translation), post_vio, consecutive-epoch TDCP, LiDAR-only Hessian, offline time calibration, A58 row noise; development-set arm, not an evaluation arm

LIVGO-v2-paper.label: LIVGO-v2 with the paper's row strength (A75): flat sigma_TDCP 1 mm, sigma_D 0.05 m/s plus the IMU-bridge terms; development-set arm, not an evaluation arm

LIVGO-literal.label: LIVGO-literal (A80): the paper's method as written on the A75 machinery: eq. (2)-(3) frame solved once after 50 m with the registered tilt rule and frozen (tilt, yaw, translation), hard C/N0 35 / elevation 15 pre-screen, main frequency only, DTW, consecutive-epoch fixed-anchor TDCP, post_vio, A58 row noise; development-set arm, not an evaluation arm

LIVGO-literal-paper.label: LIVGO-literal with the paper's row strength (A80): flat sigma_TDCP 1 mm, sigma_D 0.05 m/s plus the IMU-bridge terms; development-set arm, not an evaluation arm

LIVGO-literal-diag.label: A81 calibration: LIVGO-literal with the per-satellite diagnostic gnss_sats.csv (an output only; the estimate is bit-identical to LIVGO-literal's)

LIVGO-literal-paper-diag.label: A81 calibration: LIVGO-literal-paper with the per-satellite diagnostic gnss_sats.csv (an output only; the estimate is bit-identical to LIVGO-literal-paper's)

T-dualrej.label: T plus IV-E Hessian switch only: Mode A keeps L4/L5, Mode B drops them, pseudorange stays in the filter

T-obs.label: calibration: T in OBSERVE, L0 C/N0 and std masks open, gnss_sats.csv

T-diag-nofj.label: A62 diagnostic: T-diag with the A61 F9 frame-jump detector off

L-PVT-nofj.label: A62 diagnostic: L-PVT with the A61 F9 frame-jump detector off

L-PVT-noodom.label: A62 diagnostic: L-PVT without the A61 F13 odometry output (no Origin clone)

T-diag-nocons.label: A67/A70 diagnostic: T-diag with the Doppler rows' full tilt content (no consider, no projection: the pre-A66 gain)

T-qos.label: A67 diagnostic: T with the registration walk's q_tilt / q_tv of the open-sky sequences (A59 judgement 10 (3))

T-consider.label: A70 diagnostic: T with the A66 consider entry instead of the A70 projection (the A66 T)

T-proj-consider.label: A70 diagnostic: T with the A70 projection and the A66 consider entry (the A67 D2 configuration)

LIVGO-literal-recheck-smartpnt-diag.label: A81 one model-noise recheck, smartpnt_mini; development only

LIVGO-literal-recheck-mars-diag.label: A81 one model-noise recheck, mars_lvig; development only
